purpose: Controlled vocabulary for educational Signal Intelligence observations. Terms label awareness topics — not attack techniques and not SOC ticket types.
languageNotes: Prefer calm situational language: notice, advisory, disruption, elevated activity.
Avoid alarmist headlines and gamified 'threat scores'.
Public-safety RF topics require local legal compliance reminders.
Cyber terms describe awareness (patch, backup, advisory) — never exploitation guidance.
